thread:
Eli (NovaPay): hey team — NovaPay wants to onboard a custom model for transaction categorization + a lightweight fraud-score signal. want to check safety/data constraints and an eval plan. current ask: fine-tune small LLaMA variant on 6 months of labeled txn data (PII redacted).
Jordan (CSM): thanks Eli — looped in Priya and Liam. is there a target latency or throughput requirement? also renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks so we should prioritize.
Eli (NovaPay): aiming for real-time enrichment (<120ms p95) on live webhooks, but batch embed jobs for analytics can be slower. throughput ~200 qps sustained with spikes to 1k for holiday runs.
Priya (ML Onboarding): this is doable but two flags: 1) fine-tuning on labeled txn data with redaction — need sample schema + redaction proof. 2) model evals: we'll want an in-domain eval suite (precision/recall), adversarial safety checks, and drift benchmarks. can you share a 1000-row sample?
Eli (NovaPay): attaching sample now (sent privately). quick note: some records still have tokenized card fragments; we've masked them but want to confirm on your end.
Liam (Security): @Jordan @Priya please ensure NovaPay's KMS/HSM key policy is compatible. For private deployments we require customer-managed keys or an approved key escrow flow. also need a data flow diagram and retention TTL on training artifacts.
Mateo (Solutions Eng): for the latency target, recommending Redwood Dedicated with a quantized variant. early estimate: 80–110ms p95 on an a10x GPU pool with continuous batching off for webhook paths. we'll also add KV-prefix caching for repeat merchants.
Priya (ML Onboarding): proposed onboarding plan: 1) sample validation (privacy + schema) 2) offline eval with holdout set (metrics: accuracy, F1, false positive rate) 3) adversarial test (prompt + obfuscation) 4) safety review (Liam) 5) canary on dedicated pool + monitor. timeline ~3 weeks if sample data OK.
Jordan (CSM): action items: Eli to confirm sample and retention TTL; NovaPay legal to sign DPA addendum for training data; Priya to draft eval matrix; Liam to list KMS/TLS requirements; Mateo to produce perf estimate and cost delta for Dedicated.
Eli (NovaPay): copying legal — they asked if we can avoid storing training artifacts beyond 30 days. also need to know fallback plan if model regresses post-rollout.
Liam (Security): 30-day retention is acceptable with ephemeral training envs. fallback: we must have model version pin + auto rollback to prior version if key eval metrics drop >5% in production for 3 consecutive checks. we'll put rollback policy in the onboarding runbook.
onboard-bot: onboarding ticket #ONB-4982 created by Jordan. link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/ONB-4982
Priya (ML Onboarding): I'll mock up a minimal eval matrix and a sample adversarial prompt list by EOD tomorrow. anyone want to sync 30m today to align on canary thresholds?
Jordan (CSM): let's do 30m at 3pm PT. Eli — does that work?
Eli (NovaPay): 3pm PT works. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Mateo (Solutions Eng): added perf notes to ticket. will include cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted with quantization options.
Jordan (CSM): recording meeting invite and adding renewal risk note — if onboarding slips >2 weeks, escalate to AM. closing on thread until sync.
